body:
> Blog · Prestige · 2026-08-01

# Brief
- Title: Sewer Smell in the House? How to Find the Source and Fix It
- Slug: /blog/sewer-smell-in-house/. Role: Support 1, the cluster hub and router. Intent: informational. About 1,670 words.
- Primary keyword: sewer smell in house. Secondaries: why does my house smell like sewage, sewer gas smell in house, sewer smell comes and goes, rotten egg smell in the house, is sewer gas dangerous.

# Angle
Four sources cover nearly every case: a dried-out trap (the most common), a failed toilet seal, a vent problem, or the sewer line itself (the least common and the only big repair). Sections cover the causes, room-by-room and by-timing tracking, whether sewer gas is dangerous, the fix for each cause, when to call a plumber, and an FAQ.

# Cannibalization control
- The live post drain-smells-like-sewage covers one drain, trap or vent and stays the deep-dive. This hub links to it.
- sewage-smell-after-rain covers weather-triggered infiltration and is linked, not repeated.
- This post is the whole-house router, adding non-drain causes (wax ring, vent stack) and the diagnostic.

# Flag status
- Depends on the pillar and the rain post being live, because its down-links would 404 otherwise. Publish after both.
- First-hand proof is optional. Gated for Scott: pricing, free language, warranties, emergency rates.

# Status
Drip Day 4 (scheduled 2026-08-05). Not yet published per the cluster list.
